title: 電腦操作
description: 電腦使用與操作的常用表達

sentences.en: The file that I saved on the desktop yesterday seems to have disappeared after the system update.
sentences.zh: 我昨天存在桌面的檔案在系統更新後似乎消失了。

sentences.en: Before shutting down the computer, make sure you have saved all your documents and closed every running application.
sentences.zh: 在關閉電腦之前，請確保你已儲存所有文件並關閉每個正在執行的應用程式。

sentences.en: The keyboard shortcut that most people forget about is the one used to switch between open windows quickly.
sentences.zh: 大多數人忘記的鍵盤快捷鍵是用來快速切換開啟視窗的那個。

sentences.en: After installing the new graphics card, which was recommended by several tech reviewers, the computer runs significantly faster.
sentences.zh: 安裝了幾位科技評測者推薦的新顯示卡之後，電腦運行速度明顯加快了。

sentences.en: I need to back up all my important files to an external hard drive before reformatting the entire system.
sentences.zh: 在重新格式化整個系統之前，我需要將所有重要檔案備份到外接硬碟。

sentences.en: The monitor, which I purchased last month at a considerable discount, has excellent color accuracy for photo editing.
sentences.zh: 我上個月以相當大的折扣購買的螢幕，在照片編輯方面有極佳的色彩準確度。

sentences.en: To adjust the screen resolution, you need to right-click on the desktop and select the display settings option.
sentences.zh: 要調整螢幕解析度，你需要在桌面上按右鍵並選擇顯示設定選項。

sentences.en: The computer has been running slowly ever since I installed that program, which consumes too much memory.
sentences.zh: 自從我安裝了那個佔用太多記憶體的程式後，電腦一直運行緩慢。

sentences.en: Having connected the printer to the network, I was finally able to print documents from any device in the office.
sentences.zh: 將印表機連接到網路之後，我終於能從辦公室的任何裝置列印文件了。

sentences.en: The USB port on the left side of my laptop, which has been loose for weeks, finally stopped working altogether.
sentences.zh: 我筆電左側那個已經鬆動好幾週的USB連接埠，終於完全停止運作了。

sentences.en: If the computer freezes while you are working on an important document, try pressing Ctrl-Alt-Delete to open the task manager.
sentences.zh: 如果電腦在你處理重要文件時當機，試著按Ctrl-Alt-Delete來開啟工作管理員。

sentences.en: Upgrading the RAM from eight to sixteen gigabytes, which is a relatively simple process, dramatically improved my multitasking performance.
sentences.zh: 將記憶體從八GB升級到十六GB——這是一個相對簡單的過程——大幅改善了我的多工處理效能。

sentences.en: The operating system, designed to be user-friendly and secure, requires regular updates to maintain optimal performance.
sentences.zh: 這個被設計為使用者友善且安全的作業系統，需要定期更新以維持最佳效能。

sentences.en: Rather than buying a new computer, I decided to replace the old hard drive with a solid-state drive for better speed.
sentences.zh: 與其買一台新電腦，我決定用固態硬碟取代舊硬碟以獲得更快的速度。

sentences.en: The files that were accidentally deleted from the recycle bin can sometimes be recovered using specialized data recovery software.
sentences.zh: 從資源回收筒中意外刪除的檔案，有時可以使用專業的資料救援軟體來恢復。

sentences.en: While transferring large files between folders, the progress bar indicates how much time remains until the operation is complete.
sentences.zh: 在資料夾之間傳輸大型檔案時，進度條會顯示操作完成還需要多少時間。

sentences.en: To prevent unauthorized access to your computer, it is essential to set up a strong password and enable two-factor authentication.
sentences.zh: 為了防止未經授權存取你的電腦，設定一個強密碼並啟用雙重驗證是必要的。

sentences.en: The webcam attached to the top of my monitor, which I use for daily video calls, produces surprisingly clear images.
sentences.zh: 裝在我螢幕頂部的網路攝影機——我每天用來視訊通話的——拍出來的影像清晰得令人驚訝。

sentences.en: After the power outage caused my computer to shut down unexpectedly, I had to run a disk check to ensure no files were corrupted.
sentences.zh: 停電導致我的電腦意外關機後，我必須執行磁碟檢查以確保沒有檔案損壞。

sentences.en: The dual-monitor setup, which allows me to work on multiple tasks simultaneously, has greatly increased my daily productivity.
sentences.zh: 雙螢幕設置讓我能同時處理多項任務，大幅提升了我的日常生產力。

sentences.en: Connecting to the office network through a VPN, which encrypts all transmitted data, ensures that my work remains secure.
sentences.zh: 透過VPN連接到辦公室網路——它會加密所有傳輸的資料——確保我的工作保持安全。

sentences.en: The laptop battery, which used to last eight hours on a full charge, now barely holds enough power for three hours.
sentences.zh: 筆電電池以前充滿電可以用八小時，現在勉強只能撐三小時。

sentences.en: Before dragging the file into the folder, make sure you have selected the correct destination to avoid misplacing important documents.
sentences.zh: 在將檔案拖入資料夾之前，請確認你選擇了正確的目的地，以避免放錯重要文件。

sentences.en: The computer technician, who has over fifteen years of experience, suggested that I should replace the thermal paste on my processor.
sentences.zh: 那位有超過十五年經驗的電腦技術人員建議我應該更換處理器上的散熱膏。

sentences.en: Although the computer appears to be off, it may still be consuming power if the sleep mode indicator light is blinking.
sentences.zh: 雖然電腦看起來是關閉的，但如果睡眠模式指示燈在閃爍，它可能仍在耗電。

sentences.en: Having formatted the external drive as NTFS, I was able to store files larger than four gigabytes without any issues.
sentences.zh: 將外接硬碟格式化為NTFS之後，我能夠毫無問題地儲存超過四GB的檔案。

sentences.en: The desktop icons, which I arranged by category last week, got scattered randomly after the latest operating system update.
sentences.zh: 我上週按類別排列的桌面圖示，在最近一次作業系統更新後被隨機打亂了。

sentences.en: To free up disk space on your computer, consider uninstalling programs that you no longer use and emptying the recycle bin.
sentences.zh: 要釋放電腦的磁碟空間，請考慮解除安裝你不再使用的程式並清空資源回收筒。

sentences.en: The fan inside my computer, which has been making a strange noise for days, probably needs to be cleaned or replaced soon.
sentences.zh: 我電腦裡面的風扇已經發出奇怪的噪音好幾天了，可能很快需要清理或更換。

sentences.en: Copying the entire project folder to a cloud storage service ensures that your work is protected even if the local drive fails.
sentences.zh: 將整個專案資料夾複製到雲端儲存服務，可以確保即使本機硬碟故障，你的工作也受到保護。
